executive_summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals (ZBA) meeting on July 22, 2026, addressed several variance applications. The board discussed applications related to property modifications, including garage construction, home additions, and porch constructions. Key concerns included compliance with zoning regulations, neighborhood impact, and the necessity of proposed changes. The board voted on each application, with some approved and others denied without prejudice, allowing applicants to revise and resubmit their proposals.

key_topics.summary: The board discussed a variance application to construct a two-car garage on an undersized flag lot, considering recent zoning changes affecting setbacks.
The board reviewed a variance request for a home addition and deck, focusing on lot coverage and neighborhood impact, ultimately denying the application without prejudice.
The board considered a variance to construct a covered roof over an existing patio, which was approved unanimously.
The board deliberated on a variance for constructing a front porch, which was approved unanimously.

decisions_and_votes.description: Variance for 98 Haviland Road to construct a two-car garage
Variance for 21 Nichols Avenue for home addition and deck
Variance for 15 Verplank Avenue to construct a covered roof over patio
Variance for 21 Crest Hill Place to construct a front porch
